source: Spec-neighborhood mutations of the minimized foldkit-117 WebSocket callback contract; these wrapped producers are controls, not an additional original Foldkit witness. Plain and async functions keep TypeScript semantics. Promise/iterator wrappers do not declare the returned Effect value's failure channel.

cases.before:
import { Effect } from 'effect'
export const managedResources = () => ({ chatSocket: { acquire: async () => Effect.callback<number, Error>(resume => { resume(Effect.fail(new Error('Failed to connect to WebSocket'))) }) } })
cases.after: export const managedResources = () => ({ chatSocket: { acquire: effect (): number!Error => (effect { throw new Error('connect'); }) catch effect (error) => { throw new Error('Failed to connect to WebSocket'); } } })
